channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Gold, silver slip on MCX as traders book profits
item.description: The decline came amid weak demand in the spot market, although losses were limited because the US dollar weakened and investors expect the US Federal Reserve to announce a rate cut this week.

item.title: ECI considering appointing micro-observers for second stage of SIR in Bengal
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) is considering appointing micro-observers for the second stage of the three-level Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in West Bengal, which will start after the publication of the draft electoral roll on December 1

item.title: Junior Women’s Hockey WC: India clinch 3-1 victory over Wales
item.description: Indian Junior women’s team registered a 3-1 win against Wales in their 9/11 qualification match of the FIH Junior Women’s World Cup, held at the Centro Deportivo de Hockey Cesped, Estadio Nacional in Santiago.

item.title: IndiGo disruption: 16 flights cancelled in J&K, passengers suffer
item.description: Disruption in IndiGo Airlines' services on Monday adversely affected flight operations at Jammu and Kashmir’s Srinagar international airport as 16 flights of the airline were cancelled.

item.title: Three flights land safely at Hyderabad airport after bomb threats
item.description: Bomb threats to three flights, including two international flights, sent authorities at Hyderabad’s Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA) into a tizzy.

item.title: TVK files fresh application for Dec 16 Erode rally after police deny permission
item.description: After district police denied permission citing space and security concerns, TVK, the party of actor-politician Vijay, on Monday filed a fresh application seeking approval to hold his proposed public rally in Erode on December 16, signalling its determination to go ahead with the key campaign event despite the initial setback.

item.title: Genelia Deshmukh’s Monday reminder: You can handle whatever the week throws at you
item.description: Bollywood actress Genelia Deshmukh turned motivator on Monday morning as she posted a brief note reminding everyone that the week ahead is manageable, no matter what it holds.

item.title: Kerala court acquits actor Dileep in 2017 actress abduction case
item.description: In a dramatic conclusion to one of Kerala’s most sensational criminal trials, Malyalam actor Dileep was on Monday acquitted by the Ernakulam Principal Sessions Court in the 2017 actress abduction and sexual assault case.

item.title: BRO sets single-day record inaugurating 125 infrastructure projects
item.description: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh dedicated 125 strategic infrastructure projects built by the Border Roads Organisation to the nation, marking the largest single‑day inauguration in the organisation’s history, an official statement said.

item.title: Traffic Restrictions in Hyderabad as Telangana Global Summit Begins Today
item.description: The Telangana government is organizing a two-day Telangana Global Summit under the theme “Telangana Rising” at Bharat Future City. A total of 154 international delegates from 44 countries will attend the event.
